# Agent Action Surety (llms.txt)
> Zero-dependency execution firewall, path sandbox, command interceptor, and cryptographic audit ledger for AI coding agents.

## Entity & Governance
- project: agent-action-surety
- npmPackage: @nymrel/agent-surety
- pythonPackage: agent_action_surety
- parentOrganization: Nymrel -> JalenBuilds LLC
- contact: contact@jalenbuilds.com
- license: MIT
- repository: https://github.com/nymrel/agent-action-surety

## Core Capabilities
- Execution Firewall: Evaluates tool call requests before dispatch.
- Deny-by-Default Policy Engine: Requires explicit capability grants (fs:read, fs:write, exec:read_only, exec:modify, cloud:read, etc.).
- Path Containment Sandbox: Restricts filesystem writes to bounded workspace root; blocks traversal, symlink escapes, and secret theft (.env, .ssh, .aws).
- Command Interceptor: Inspects SQL, Shell, Git, Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes, and Package Managers for destructive patterns.
- Spend & Rate Bounds: Enforces financial budgets, token ceilings, and sliding-window rate limits.
- Cryptographic Audit Ledger: Emits tamper-evident SHA-256 Merkle-linked execution receipts.

## TypeScript / Node Quickstart
```typescript
import { PolicyEngine, SuretySandbox, CommandInterceptor, ExecutionLedger, wrapExecution } from '@nymrel/agent-surety';

const engine = new PolicyEngine({
  capabilities: ['fs:read', 'fs:write', 'exec:read_only'],
  allowedPaths: ['./src', './tests'],
  maxSpendUsd: 10.0,
  rateLimitPerMinute: 60,
});

const result = await wrapExecution(engine, {
  actionType: 'exec',
  command: 'rm -rf /', // Intercepted and blocked immediately
  workingDir: process.cwd(),
});
```

## Python Quickstart
```python
from agent_action_surety import PolicyEngine, wrap_execution

engine = PolicyEngine(
    capabilities=["fs:read", "fs:write", "exec:read_only"],
    allowed_paths=["./src", "./tests"],
    max_spend_usd=10.0,
    rate_limit_per_minute=60,
)

result = wrap_execution(
    engine,
    action_type="exec",
    command="rm -rf /",  # Blocked with ViolationReport
    working_dir=".",
)
```

## CLI Wrapper
```bash
# Intercept command using default strict policy
agent-surety exec --cmd "git push --force origin main" --deny-destructive
```
